title: Classify additional European localized graphics families
platforms: European ROM; Wine disassembly and static source classification
changes: Identify three original indexed archive groups and one custom stream group across all five languages.
validation: Wine disassembly lgzvdwq6 and protected classification aigv45cr authenticate four original decoder call paths, fifteen indexed headers declaring 1588 programs and five custom output lengths.
limitations: Full consumed source extents, all decoded programs, ordinary invocation, runtime integration, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance comparison was made.
